test_case.test_name: Per-lane interlocked HGX NVQual Test #25 Tx Equalization interoperability
test_case.purpose: Prove every approved Test #25 Tx-equalization redo completes the required phases on the mapped lanes and restores required link and NVIDIA function without hang, unplanned reboot or disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #25 Tx-eq package/configuration with compatible firmware/driver
Signed root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane topology and stable identity map
Approved generation/width, phases, preset/coefficient ownership, redo/settle/transient/deadline and per-lane rules
Signed iteration count/timing, durable atomic redo ledger and first-fault interlock
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, BMC/console, stable power/cooling and out-of-band recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Export/hash baseline equalization/link/inventory/error evidence. After point approval run only the pinned Test #25 Tx Eq Redo primitive; per redo durably record request, phase/LTSSM and per-lane status, settled generation/width, complete NVIDIA identities, driver/GPU readiness, timing and error/health deltas before another redo. Stop on first anomaly; do not alter coefficients, reset, power-cycle or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every configured redo completes approved equalization phases on every required lane, settles by deadline at expected generation/width, retains the complete NVIDIA identity/function set, passes all Test #25 items, and causes no hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying new errors.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until Test #25 recipe, lane/path map, equalization rules, iterations and recovery are approved. PASS requires every complete accepted redo. FAIL on phase/lane failure, timeout/downtrain, device identity/function loss, hang/reboot, unapproved setting change, disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; retries cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact recipe/path/lane, parameter ownership, iteration/acceptance, ledger/interlock and recovery are signed.
Preserve baseline logs; never alter presets/coefficients outside the vendor recipe.
Use an isolated idle SUT with console and explicit long-run signal-training authorization.
Stop without reset/power escalation or retry on first lane/link/device/platform/evidence anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #25 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities plus complete path/per-lane and stable NVIDIA identity map
Per-redo atomic phase/lane/LTSSM, timing, negotiated link, full NVIDIA identity/function and disposition ledger
First-fault/out-of-band recovery or clean final link/device/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At failed phase/lane, timeout/downtrain, device identity/function loss, hang/reboot, unapproved setting change, disqualifying error or artifact gap, inhibit later redos and preserve the first event. Do not reset, power-cycle or replay as a substitute; follow signed recovery and quarantine if expected link/topology/health is not restored.
